Individual statements would need to be reviewed separately to determine relevance to Self Assessment specifically.
Some upstream dates appear to be future-dated (e.g. 2026-05-29 for SP 1 (2001)), which may reflect a review/republish date rather than original issue date.

note.summary: This is a full index listing of 135 HMRC Statements of Practice documents from GOV.UK, spanning publication dates from 1965 to 2026, including both obsolete/withdrawn collections and numbered/lettered individual statements. It provides titles, upstream last-updated dates, and links but no substantive tax content itself. Statements of Practice set out HMRC's interpretation of tax law and administrative practice, which may be relevant to Self Assessment matters covered in specific statements not detailed in this chunk.
